title: The Facial Common Neighbourhood Graph
summary: Given a polyhedron (planar, $3$-connected graph) $G$, we investigate its common neighbourhood graph con($G$). For cubic ($3$-regular) polyhedra, we show that the planarity of con($G$) depends on the number of odd faces of $G$, and on their adjacency. We then prove that for all other polyhedra, con($G$) is non-planar. We introduce a novel concept for polyhedra (and more generally, for plane graphs) $G$, namely the `facial common neighbourhood graph' facecon($G$).
